request.deadline: Delivery period is August 2026 to July 2027
deliverables: Maintain and develop Eternl frontend across web, browser extension, iOS, Android, and beta channels
Maintain backend infrastructure including multi-region servers, Cardano nodes, DBSync indexers, application servers, metadata aggregation, Hub services, monitoring, alerting, and incident response
Provide user support through Discord, Telegram, public channels, project support, wiki updates, and educational videos
Enhance governance tooling including DRep dashboards, proposal browsers, in-wallet voting, and proposal creation
Develop upcoming features including Eternl Core rewrite, Eternl Hub, enhanced hardware wallet support, Bluetooth mobile support, and wallet data export
Perform independent audits of treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027
Publish oversight metrics including balances, conversion rates, transaction hashes, and repayment hashes
request.what: 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, and improvements, including frontend and backend maintenance and development, backend infrastructure, user support, day-to-day operations, audits of fund use, and oversight metrics.

claims.claim: Eternl is a non-custodial Cardano light wallet available for web, browser extension, Android, and iOS.
The proposal requests ₳2,350,000 to cover approximately $420,000 in annual operating costs for a 12-month period.
The proposed budget funds 6.0 FTE distributed across 10 contributors at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl plans to introduce paid Pro plans at $96 per year for personal users and $360 per year for company users.
The proposer states that about 5,500 Pro users, roughly 4.2% of its stated install base, would fully cover the annual $420,000 cost.
The proposer states Eternl has about 100,000 browser extension installs and about 30,000 Android and iOS installs.
The proposer states 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
The proposer commits to convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins, hold it in a public company wallet, and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

The proposer commits to semiannual treasury repayments using surplus treasury stablecoins plus paid plan income until $420,000 in Ada is repaid, followed by possible additional donations capped at $210,000 worth of Ada.
The proposer states independent fund-use audits will occur in February 2027 and August 2027 by a party unaffiliated with Tastenkunst GmbH or the Eternl team.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for 12 months of Eternl operations administered by Tastenkunst GmbH, presents a paid-plan path to sustainability and repayment mechanism, and includes operational scope and audit commitments, but key adoption and usage figures are mostly proposer asserted within the anchor text.
